about: What you say on camera for the live beat. Public content only. Each segment becomes one Bee segment (one window). Rehearse with: node scripts/build-rehearsal.ts, then live mode --from demo/rehearsal.jsonl --stay.

segments.summary: Speaker reflects that Bee segments the day but the CLI hides the segments.
lines: Bee already splits my day into segments, with a one-line summary for each.
And the command line just drops them. Nobody can see the best thing it does.

segments.summary: Speaker asks for bee stream to show new-utterance-chunks events with their summaries.
lines: Make bee stream show new-utterance-chunks events as readable lines with each chunk's summary, and list it as a supported event type.

rehearsal_answer: Each event has a chunks array. Every chunk has chunk_text, a tags array and a list of utterance ids. Show the chunk text and tags on one line per chunk. Go ahead.
